Defence Legislation Amendment (Woomera Prohibited Area) Bill 2013

Moved the Defence Legislation Amendment (Woomera Prohibited Area) Bill 2013 implementing the Hawke review, creating a permit system to allow non-defence mining and resources access to the 127,000 square kilometre military testing range while defence remains the primary user, noting the South Australian government estimates about $35 billion in exploitable minerals within the area, and capped compensation for property loss at $2 million.
